_comment: Chair-shaped NC bills whose operative text was READ AT SOURCE and matched against the ladder,
with each bill's full sponsor list. This is the campaign's working index: pull a bill's list ONCE,
then read it across the roster. Batch 04 produced 26 rows on four new source reads using this.
HOW TO USE: resolve each surname through nc-house-member-ids.json BY DISTRICT, never by name.
ncleg prints bare surnames with initials -- G./K./T. Brown are three different members, A. Jones
and B. Jones are two, R. Pierce and G. Pierce are two, F./N. Jackson are two.
BEFORE SEATING, CHECK conflicts_blank_these. A member on two bills pointing at adjacent chairs on
the same topic gets a BLANK, not the first chair you happened to find.
Sponsor lists were captured from BillLookUp via a summarising fetch. Treat them as a worklist:
re-confirm on the bill page before seating a member not already cross-checked.
PRIMARY SPONSORSHIP must be confirmed on the BILL page. A member's IntroducedBills page lists bills
they introduced, not only ones they primarily sponsored -- that error put a wrong sentence into a
live row for Alston and had to be corrected in prod.

bills.short_title: Equit. Escalation of Electricity Demand Act

bills.note: Deregulation PLUS $40M at 60-120% AMI in ONE bill. That pairing is why chair 3 fits and chair 4 does not.
This ladder runs the OPPOSITE way: chair 1 = least oversight. Disclosure plus liability, no safety testing.
Pure deregulation, no money. Chair 4 only holds if the member has NO housing appropriation elsewhere.
ADU mandate, no money. Same caveat as H765 -- pairs with a subsidy bill into chair 3 instead.
Permitting incentives only. NOT a chair on its own; combines with a money bill to make chair 3.

bills.short_title: Fair Share for Public Schools Act
bills.note: 7% bracket above $1M into the State Public School Fund. States a RATE and a DESTINATION, which is what lets it clear the significantly-vs-moderately problem CLAUDE.md warns about.
PINS NOTHING. Section 1 creates deepfake liability; Section 2 grants developers immunity. Anyone whose only AI instrument is this bill gets a BLANK.

senate_bills.note: Stops new voucher grants, winds the program down, moves $113.46M recurring to public schools. Both clauses of chair 1.
ADU mandate, NO appropriation. Alone it reads chair 4, not 3.
HELD. Halting a scheduled corporate cut is not raising a tax.
HELD. Restoring down-zoning authority is not named by any chair.
